verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch documents an official CLI on its own docs site. Users can work with the platform from a terminal or an automated system to run API tests, automate monitoring and manage collections. The `hopp test` command is documented, including JUnit report generation for collection runs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use, and evidence of agent-oriented features such as machine-readable output or documented use by AI agents.
